name: Formosa Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
summary: Formosa Pharmaceuticals, Inc., a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, engages in developing drug candidates for ophthalmology, oncology, and anti-infectives in Taiwan. It is involved in developing TSY-110, an antibody-drug conjugate; and TSY-0210, an antibiotic for drug resistant infections. The company also develops APP13002 to treat infectious eye diseases, such as conjunctivitis, keratitis, blepharitis, and meibomian gland dysfunction; and MPT0E028, a novel pan- histone deacetylase inhibitor for solid tumors, such as hepatomas and colorectal cancer. It has a strategic partnership with Eyenovia, Inc. for the development of novel ophthalmic therapeutic; and Singapore Eye Research Institute to develop ophthalmic formulations for corneal diseases. Formosa Pharmaceuticals, Inc. was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.
